STORY SO FAR: Fri 08-14, day 3 in country, first session since the plane. THE ERA HAS TURNED -- the field mission is now the session's INPUT, and the first one paid.

MISSION LANDED, REAL ROOM. Wednesday's op was to PROPOSE with -laamaa instead of announcing. Thursday's first real meal with amma-appa: he fired 'saapidalaamaa' at the table, unprompted, plate in front of him, nobody in his ear. Counted COLD at frame:mayi-laama -- the word was handed to him in a knock two days earlier, but retrieval in the room with no prompt present is the only test that matters. Four days after 'market-ku poganum, avasaram irukku' (his own business, announced) he pulled the room in instead.

ANDREW CORRECTED MY FRAMING, and it is the keeper of the day. I fished for a dramatic reaction ('did the room go quiet?') and he shut it down: 'We are not looking for jaw drop silent rooms. Just unexpected tidbits of understanding or replies.' Small and real is the signal he wants collected. Stop writing theatre into the debrief ask.

THE HOUSE'S LAW, CONFIRMED LIVE: 'of course extra idlis were served without being asked.' The Oracle was right -- seconds arrive unasked. So the RECEIVING set is nearly dead weight and the DECLINING / self-serve set is what he needs three times a day. Retarget delight accordingly.

I COULD NOT STOP SCAFFOLDING, AGAIN. Asked him to STOP the food; he gave 'innum konjam podunga' (which asks for MORE) -- chunk-not-machine, second sitting running: he fires the line sitting in front of him, not the move the room wants. Then I named 'podhum' and 'neenga ukkarunga' in the setup and asked for them back -- both logged HINTED, said to his face. The 08-09 lesson is still mine to learn: an ambush is only an ambush if the prompt reads as normal to someone not being tested.

THE ONE THAT COUNTS. Real ambush (mid-afternoon kitchen, athai already getting up to help, nothing named): NAANE EDUTHUKKAREN, cold, unaided, first ask -- a delight-tier item that was struggled/cold-pending. Delight is the starving lane.

DECOMPOSITION IS STILL THE HIGHEST-YIELD MOVE AND HE NOW ASKS FOR IT UNPROMPTED. He asked me to break naane eduthukkaren apart: naan + -e / edu + -thukka + -ren, and he already owned edunga, paathukkaren, poren/varen/solren. The -thukka tail is the load-bearing part -- edukkaren is 'I am taking it', eduthukkaren is 'leave it, I have got it', and that tail is the entire reason athai sits back down. Then he fired -e on a NOVEL slot (amma asks who made the coffee -> 'naane'), which is the exact antidote to chunk-not-machine: slot swapped, chunk not re-fired. -e came off the EAR-ONLY catch pile into his mouth the same way jaasthi did on 08-09.

HIS OWN QUESTION IS THE NEXT COMMISSION: 'podunga is confusing me because it sounds like the verb po, to go.' A real collision one syllable apart, both live at a table. He raised it himself -- same standing as the pakkam/paakkalaam request on 07-27, which means honour it and drill it BOTH directions, by ear and by mouth.

I BROKE THE SURFACE SPLIT. Wrote the whole decomposition in Tamil script; he came back with 'can you repeat using phonetics, I cannot read all these Tamil letters especially super tiny as they appear in the terminal.' Second friction report on that boundary this week. Anything he READS is phonetic -- breakdowns and word-part carving included. No exceptions in terminal chat.

M88 SHIPPED at session open (the -la negative machine; first cut bounced a fourth-wall lint, second went clean). Unlistened.

FIRES: 4 cold (frame:mayi-laama live at her table, frame:giveme-noun, naane eduthukkaren, the -e clitic on a novel slot) + 2 hinted (podhum, ukkarunga).

STILL OPEN: puriyala-for-reopen (M88 carries it, unlistened). english-word-order still 2x and escalated, NOT tested today. Volley 2/4 and 3/4 unanswered since 08-11, and this morning's Savitha akka eavesdrop tape unopened -- knocks were held through 08-13 and have only just resumed. Watch item still n=1: English-shaped noun where the Tamil wants a verb. TONIGHT'S MISSION: stop someone serving you and do it yourself -- naane eduthukkaren, in the room, at any meal. The house guarantees the slot three times a day.

soak_order.scene_seed: a wedding-morning house where one cousin is putting everything on -- the music, the lights, the food, the garland -- while another is being sent everywhere at once, and nobody has time to explain why the two words are different
soak_order.focus: the one-syllable collision Andrew found himself: po (go) vs podu (put). ponga and podunga are a single -du apart and both live at a table, where the wrong one tells your mother-in-law to clear off. Make the -du AUDIBLE by putting the pair back to back across a scene -- ponga, podunga, potten, po -- and carve what each one BUYS, not just how it sounds. He already owns podu (sattai podu) and ponga (medhuva ponga) and has never had them side by side; this is the inventory method on a PAIR rather than a tail. Ride -thukka in the background (eduthukkaren, paathukkaren) as the leave-it-to-me move, since seconds always arrive unasked in that house and declining is what it actually demands of him.
